title: Chapter 148: Bandits Approach The City
content:
Chapter 148: Bandits Approach The City

Wang Shuo looked at Ayub and asked nervously: "Abu, are you sure?"

Ayub snorted disdainfully: "A country chicken and a clay dog!"

"Brothers under the city, have you had breakfast?" Wang Shuo was in a good mood and joked.

Wang Shuo glanced again. There must be a leader among these mobs.

Soon, Wang Shuo found a sturdy man.

He was full of flesh, with a tiger skin wrapped around his upper body, a belt made of tiger skin, and a machete in his hand. He was looking at Wang Shuo indifferently with a wicked smile.

Wang Shuo frowned and felt a little worried.
